original_question:
Mark yɛ nsɔhwɛ bi a na ɛyɛ nsɛmmisa 75. Na ɔwie nsɛmmisa 5 wɔ dɔnhwere baako mu wɔ nsɔhwɛ. 
Ɛnnɛ, ɔyɛɛ nsɔhwɛ foforo a nsɛmmisa 100 wom wɔ bere baako mu. Sɛ na Mark wɔ nnɔnhwere 8 a ɔde wiee nsɔhwɛ a edi kan no na ɔwɔ nnɔnhwere 6 a ɔde wiee nea ɛto so mmienu no a, nsɛmmisa ahe na na ɔnwiee?
